Extract og:title, og:description, and og:image from Open Graph meta tags

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<html><head><title>Fallback Title</title><meta property="og:title" content="OG Title"><meta property="og:description" content="OG description text."><meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/image.jpg"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.document.openGraph["title"]);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.document.openGraph["description"]);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.document.openGraph["image"]);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
